dispatch_summary: This dispatch resumed a stalled prior /implement run for task 952: Phases 1-6 were already [COMPLETED] and committed. Phase 7 (the five ephemeral hooks) had uncommitted, in-flight work in the working tree from the prior dispatch; this run inspected it (git diff against all five hooks), verified it was already correctly authored (matching the plan's SCRIPT_DIR-relative resolution idiom mirrored from events-log-lifecycle.sh, and every hook's exit-code contract preserved byte-for-byte), ran an exit-contract regression suite via synthetic stdin JSON (clean/detecting paths for all five hooks, plus a fail-open check with the shared task-reference-patterns.sh library temporarily removed), checked off the phase's task list, and committed it. Phase 8 then ran the full end-to-end acceptance test: a synthetic .return-meta.json with a bare-string artifacts array correctly fires evidence_reason=ARTIFACTS_SHAPE_MISMATCH via orchestrate-recover-outcome.sh, and driving the Phase-4 consumer arm's exact recorder invocation produced exactly one correctly-attributed specs/events.jsonl row (event_type=system_defect, category=deviation, attributed_source_path under agent-system/extensions/**). Two schema-conformant negatives (failed, partial) both produced zero new rows, confirmed via evidence_suspect=false short-circuiting the consumer arm. Dedup suppression was verified by reproducing Phase 3's own test shape (manually promoting a row's linked_task_number to a non-terminal task before re-recording); a bare re-run without promotion is, by the discrimination document's own rule, correctly NOT treated as a duplicate. All events.jsonl test rows were cleaned up and the file restored to its pre-phase committed line count. The full repository gate set (verify-deploy.sh, check-task-references.sh, check-extension-docs.sh, lint-agent-contracts.sh, lint-routing-wiring.sh, bash -n) was run to completion; verify-deploy.sh initially reported 2 of 19 checks failing due to two PRE-EXISTING, unrelated defects surfaced by this phase's own gate run (not introduced by Phase 7/8): (1) index-entries.json line_count drift for two files Phase 1 had edited without regenerating counts, fixed via generate-context-line-counts.sh --write; (2) system-defect-record.sh's D5 session-id fallback re-implemented sess_$(date...) inline instead of calling the already-sourced common_session_id from lib/common.sh, violating the repo's single-source-of-truth test (test-common-lib.sh, part of tests/run-all.sh). Both were fixed with minimal, additive, source-store-only corrections; the recorder's positive-test proof was re-verified after the fix. Final verify-deploy.sh run: PASS, 19 checks, 0 failures. Source-store boundary confirmed held throughout: git status --short shows changes only under agent-system/extensions/** and specs/**, no tracked .claude/** modification. No AskUserQuestion anywhere; no task created or surfaced by the recording pipeline (binding Non-Goal, verified).
